scope: Optional read-only held-profile classic layout snapshot; no application startup/UI/writer integration
missing: Only after each of the three fixed candidate names was observed absent; present malformed recovery is InvalidFormat
limits: Fixed ordinary core Limits:4MiB input/string,100000 nodes,root-zero depth64; default pure projection caps; no caller-configurable quotas
ownership: Borrow valid unmoved lease synchronously; return independent owned raw/projection snapshot and Primary/Backup/Saving provenance; no retained descriptor
errors: Reader errors forwarded; projection Limit->Unsupported,Memory->Io,Root/EditedDocument->InvalidFormat; observed stop->Cancelled and discards snapshot
cancellation: Before lease access; after whole ConfigFile load; before/after absence reads; after pure projection and before publication. Blocking reads are not interrupted.
limitations: Separate candidate reads are not an atomic filesystem snapshot
No recovery writes,registered column defaults,migrations,global-sort resolution,Qt column application or settings persistence
Limits bound data structures and input; no allocator/RSS/noexcept guarantee
